title: Arbitrum Security Program
description: A 12-month Arbitrum Foundation program that subsidizes a portion of a third-party smart contract audit for projects building on Arbitrum, with pre-audit AI security screening. Approved projects are matched with one of 13 audit firms, including Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, Certora, Cyfrin and Sherlock.
reward: A subsidy for a portion of the project's initial smart contract audit, set in each project's commercial agreement
summary: Audit subsidy, amount not stated · open for 12 months from Sep 28

eligibility.note: smart contract code that is audit-ready, with a defined audit scope

ideas: A lending protocol preparing its first audit
A protocol migrating its contracts to Arbitrum
A new product launch on an Arbitrum chain
setup: get the code audit-ready with a defined scope
sign a Commitment Agreement with the Foundation
each_time: audit scope, SLOC, budget and target date
founder details, cash, burn and runway
rules: The program runs 12 months from its launch on September 28, 2026; no application deadline is stated.
Eligible: projects yet to launch, migrating from another chain, in the growth stage, launching new features or products, or launching their own Arbitrum Chain.

Before an auditor is sourced, an approved project must confirm its codebase is audit-ready, agree to the applicable audit subsidy, and sign a Commitment Agreement with the Arbitrum Foundation, which may include exclusivity or other commercial commitments.
The form asks you to accept that the audited code is exclusive to Arbitrum for a set period of time.
The Foundation subsidizes a portion of each audit depending on the commercial agreement reached. Only the agreed initial audit is covered.
Plan for about one month between approval and the expected start of the audit.
Reviewed on technical maturity, team, likelihood of success, and alignment with the Arbitrum ecosystem. The form says applications are processed in about 2 weeks.
